narration_lines: The water is going away! But we still need to be careful.
Floodwater can leave mud, leaves, rubbish and dirty things behind.
Broken things can hide in mud and rubbish. Adults check before children come back.
Wet electrical things need to be checked by grown-ups.
Things touched by floodwater may need to be cleaned or thrown away. A grown-up checks before we touch or eat them.
Animals may have moved while looking for dry places. Let a grown-up check.
Grown-ups check electrical things, clear debris, clean and dry belongings, and open safe paths. They make our neighbourhood safe again.
The flood changed our neighbourhood for a while. We stayed safe, people worked together, and now we can use our familiar places again.
